issues.description: Method toString(): the solution repository declares the method as 'public Object toString()' (solution src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java lines 64-72). The problem statement asks students to implement a custom toString() and shows examples that use the standard Java toString() signature returning String (problem_statement.md lines 36-38). The template contains a TODO for adding a custom toString() (template src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 10) but does not provide a signature. Because the solution uses 'public Object toString()' together with an @Override annotation, this produces an incompatible return-type override error (Object is not a valid override of Object.toString() which returns String) and will cause compilation failure and confusion for students about the expected signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the toString() method in the solution to use the standard signature 'public String toString()' (keep the @Override annotation) and ensure it returns a String. This aligns the solution with the problem statement and allows correct overriding and compilation. Update any example text if necessary to reference the String-returning toString().
